groupings.title: Delegit: delegate to CLI agents
groupings.description: Delegate coding tasks from your agent to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Oh My Pi or Warp, then review the diff and commit it yourself.

groupings.title: Delegit: setup
groupings.description: Discover installed coding-agent CLIs and route each kind of work (features, tests, UI, reviews) to the right one.

groupings.title: Delegit: queue
groupings.description: Run several coding tasks in parallel across coding agents, each in its own git worktree, with fallback and cross-review.
